title: Playback Transcode Policy Deepening
problem: Nako has Playback Sessions and FFmpeg-backed direct/remux/HLS paths, but playback planning, client capability negotiation, transcode reasons, hardware fallback, runtime inventory, and engine execution need deeper seams before Jellyfin-class playback/transcode features are added.

evidence.summary: Opened playback/transcode policy deepening lane and ADR 0038 after reviewing Jellyfin-class playback, device profile, transcode reason, encoding option, and transcode job lifecycle pressure.
Added direct-play characterization proving Playback Session is the durable user attempt and direct play creates no fake Transcode Session artifact; refreshed playback/transcode gates.

Extracted playback planning/profile/capability/reason records into nako-playback; reduced nako-streaming to direct byte-range transport mechanics; migrated server playback app and public DTO adapters to planner output.

Promoted Public Client playback reason and capability DTOs: ClientPlaybackDecisionReason is a stable wire enum, playback sessions reuse ClientPlaybackCapabilitiesDto, and TypeScript/Kotlin SDKs were regenerated.

Replaced shallow HLS hardware selection with TranscodeExecutionPolicy: decode/filter/encode acceleration stages, fallback evidence, output constraints, and subtitle strategy now drive HLS profile identity and FFmpeg request planning; Public Client transcode plans no longer expose service-side hardware selection.

Added TranscodeRuntimeInventory and TranscodeEngineAdapter: Admin runtime diagnostics now consume a redaction-safe FFmpeg CLI capability summary, and FFmpeg remux/HLS execution exposes typed start outcomes plus progress snapshots behind the engine adapter seam.

Added persisted Admin playback runtime settings, artifact lifecycle/throttle diagnostics, generated Admin TypeScript contract refresh, and startup cleanup for terminal transcode artifacts under the configured transcode root with security-skip accounting.

Closed the lane by moving direct/remux/HLS playback orchestration from HTTP routes into PlaybackAppService, preserving browser tickets and legacy HLS segment URLs with focused playback/transcode gates.

continue_policy.notes: The lane is closed. Future work should split follow-ons for adaptive HLS ladders, optimized versions, remote transcode workers, desktop/native player integration, subtitle/HDR policy, SyncPlay, DLNA, and per-user playback permissions.
